native_mesh_correspondence.method: Map each source triangle corner to an actual 3MF vertex. Require exact oriented-face multiset equality after recording the collapsed source faces. Verify final edge/vertex manifold, winding and connectivity. Corresponding triangle points move no more than the maximum corner displacement by barycentric interpolation. This explains numerical conversion, not byte or face-count identity.
native_mesh_correspondence.scope: Exact oriented-face correspondence after bounded native vertex precision conversion; no faces lost and no physical material/process guarantee.
